title: Digital Kitabe: code and data
description:
Code and data accompanying the article Digital Kitabe: A content-derived, verifiable identity embedded in IFC models through historical geometric pattern grammars (submitted to Automation in Construction).

The Digital Kitabe is a model identity computed from the content of an IFC model through a canonical Merkle commitment (DK-C14N-1.1), stored inside the model with standard IFC entities, sealed in a signed append-only record and rendered as a pattern generated from historical geometric pattern grammars (DK-ENC-1.0).

paper/: code that reproduces the experiments (E1–E5) and figures of the article, and the reported results (Merkle trees, signed test ledger, patterns). tool/: command-line tool to stamp, verify and identify IFC models. The Snowdon Towers sample model (Autodesk) is not included.

Code: MIT licence. Data in paper/results/: CC BY 4.0.
